system.description: Pure, perfected swordsmanship that raises ordinary strikes to supernatural precision, using Ordinary weapons.
system.summary: Pure, perfected swordsmanship that raises ordinary strikes to supernatural precision, using Ordinary weapons.

entries.name: Weapon (Ordinary)
entries.effect: Special Attack must be made with a Ordinary weapon.

entries.name: Action (Aim)
entries.effect: Aim may be the base; the Advantages go to the aimed attack that follows, which is not itself a special one.

entries.name: Opening the Path
entries.effect: Once the attack is made, your Static Defense drops by 10 up to your coming turn.

entries.name: Hammer of the Emperor
entries.effect: The blow gains Tearing; the book gives it an undefined damage value X.

entries.name: Skill (Perception)
entries.effect: Roll Perception against the target's Static Defense as part of the attack; failure means the attack fails.

entries.name: Steel Wind
entries.effect: The attack targets up to two adjacent enemies.

entries.name: Mastery (Mithril Blade)
entries.effect: A foe's defensive reaction lower than your attack total does not stop your attacks.

entries.name: Exorcism of Steel
entries.effect: Your weapons gain Power Field until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Strike of Perfect Clarity
entries.effect: +1 rolled damage die per raise on the attack roll.
